documents.title: Seat allotment letter
documents.where_to_get: Download from the counselling portal after seat acceptance. Print it in colour before you travel.

documents.title: Seat acceptance fee receipt
documents.where_to_get: Download from the counselling portal after paying the seat acceptance fee.

documents.title: Migration certificate
documents.where_to_get: Issued by the board or institute you studied at last. Ask the school office early, it can take days.

documents.title: DASA or ICCR admission documents
documents.where_to_get: Use the admission letter issued through the DASA portal.

documents.title: Class 10 marksheet and certificate
documents.where_to_get: Your school or board. If lost, request a duplicate from the board.

documents.title: Class 12 marksheet and passing certificate
documents.where_to_get: Your school or board. Digital copies from DigiLocker are accepted for reference only.

documents.title: Passport-size photographs
documents.where_to_get: Any studio. Recent, plain light background. Write your name on the back of each.

documents.title: Government photo ID
documents.where_to_get: Carry the original card. Photocopy the front and back only. Never write the ID number on any form you hand out.

documents.title: OBC-NCL certificate
documents.valid_note: Must be issued on or after 1 April 2026.
documents.where_to_get: Tehsil or district e-Services portal of your home state.

documents.title: EWS certificate
documents.valid_note: Must be issued on or after 1 April 2026.
documents.where_to_get: Tehsil or district e-Services portal of your home state.

documents.title: SC or ST caste certificate
documents.where_to_get: Tehsil or district e-Services portal of your home state.

documents.title: Domicile certificate
documents.where_to_get: District office of your home state.

documents.title: Disability certificate
documents.where_to_get: Issued by a government medical board. Bring the latest one.

documents.title: Medical fitness certificate
documents.where_to_get: A registered doctor. Use the institute format and get it signed and stamped.

documents.title: Anti-ragging affidavit
documents.where_to_get: Fill in the online form, print it, and sign. A parent signs the parent section too.

documents.title: Hostel accommodation form
documents.where_to_get: Download the form from the institute site, fill it in, and hand it to the warden's office.
